figurative_meaning_en: The root cause of arrogance or haughtiness
similar_in_english: Achilles' heel (for weakness, but metaphorically for a core flaw)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অহঙ্কারের বিষদাঁত তার অর্থের অহংকার।
সেই ক্ষমতাই তার তেজের বিষদাঁত হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His wealth is the venomous fang of his arrogance.
That power has become the root cause of his haughtiness.
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of a snake's venomous fang to symbolize the hidden source of destructive pride in Bengali linguistic tradition.
